searchText: Malicious blob node Please note that I have added an extra blob schedule that will be triggered with fulu. This will not increase the blob count, but its required by some CLs not to fork away: https://github.com/ethpandaops/fusaka-devnets/commit/c7aaa8caeba8fa9c6d72bf9c76d4df523524e2a7 change has been rolled out on all nodes Two more epochs until Fulu activates on fusaka-devnet-0: https://dora.fusaka-devnet-0.ethpandaops.io Do we know who the unnamed proposers are that are missing slots? We have a bunch of servers setup in Singapore, but their apt mirror is down and we're not able to bootstrap the servers for the devnet. We've raised an issue, but those are the missing validators (when i eyeball it) im not sure why the config doesnt include them with labels though - bbusa set it up and can probably give a reason There's some forking on fusaka-devnet-0, nimbus is looking into their validators. It would be great if other CLs look into theirs as well. https://dora.fusaka-devnet-0.ethpandaops.io/slots I saw nimbus produced some blocks that's not a descendant from finalized checkpoints slots 8299 and 8301 nimbus clients are all forked off there's the main chain and 2 nimbus chains basically I think nimbus allow blocks production while node is syncing to the head of the chain? idk i wonder why the sync committee aggregation seems to be dropping.. I think we saw that being low even on local networks, haven't dug into why yet <@785811170387951616> <@654267572107083777> yeah apologies, I was expecting to have the erigon nodes up by the time the deposits hit the chain. The apt mirror made the setups delayed significantly, they are rolling out now tho. And the erigon validator values have been set on dora too. No worries! spicing things up with a bit of unfinalization 😄 Im asking client teams if you see your client not doing well, please take a look and see if there are any bugs that could be fixed. Happy to roll out any updates working on the fixes at the moment will notify as soon as things look better https://tenor.com/view/qa-developer-software-development-test-gif-27432169 `bpo-parsing-3fed785` ~~definitely need resync~~, ok no we still have peers, just rolling should do ^ rolling
